newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway pleased with UK Frigg gas treaty agreement.
newsitem.headline: Norway pleased with UK Frigg gas treaty agreement.

text.p: Norway said on Thursday an agreement with Britain on revisions to the treaty governing operations of the Frigg gas pipeline would lead to new exports of Norwegian gas.

"I am pleased that Norwegian and British authorities have now reached an agreement on the Frigg treaty, which opens for new exports of Norwegian gas to Britain and Ireland," Energy Minister Ranveig Froeiland said in a statement.
Britain was earlier the biggest receiver of Norwegian gas, but disagreement on the use of the Frigg pipeline had been an obstacle to signing new contracts, the ministry said.
"There has already been contact between British and Irish buyers and with Norwegian sellers of gas," Froeiland said. "This shows there is an interest in these countries in Norwegian gas."
